# SEO UX

Use this skill when improving content structure, metadata, page hierarchy, or site discoverability.

## Focus areas
- Clear page titles and descriptive headings.
- Logical heading order from H1 to H3.
- Meaningful landing-page copy that helps both humans and search engines.
- Strong internal linking and consistent content structure.

## Rules
- Favor useful, descriptive copy over keyword stuffing.
- Keep content structured and scannable.
- Ensure important pages remain accessible and fast.

## Example
- Good: a portfolio section with clear case study headings, concise summaries, and distinct service categories.
- Bad: vague sections with repeated text and no meaningful structure.
